name: Common Craft System
description: Accessible crafting interface open to all player classes where crafting points are accrued through monster kills to produce scrolls, consumables, and gear.

facts.charge_mechanism: Common Craft gauge fills as monsters are defeated in hunting zones; Guardian's Gratitude buff accelerates fill rate
facts.points_consumption: Fixed charge points consumed per craft attempt

notes: Essential replacement for classic Dwarf artisan reliance in Essence, allowing solo and idle characters to generate their own scrolls.

name: Special Craft System
description: Deterministic and probability-based crafting catalog allowing players to forge boss gear, immortal weapons, and coupons using designated materials.

mechanic_types: Probability Craft with partial refund on failure

notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] for Lv 1-40, provides structural blueprint for Aden Arena's endgame weapon forging.

name: Classic Dwarf Recipe Crafting
description: Foundational Lineage II crafting system where Artisan/Warsmith dwarves utilize recipe books, key materials, and basic ingredients to construct D-grade and C-grade equipment.

facts.mp_consumption: Consumes character MP upon crafting execution
